# Evenkeel

> Practical, sourced everyday-preparedness guides for households worldwide. Prepared, not scared.

## Guides

- [How do I build a home emergency food and water stock?](https://beprepareddontfear.github.io/guides/home-emergency-food-and-water-stock.html): How much water and food to store, how long pantry staples last, and a homemade kit checklist.
- [How do I store drinking water for an emergency?](https://beprepareddontfear.github.io/guides/store-emergency-drinking-water.html): How much to store, which containers to use, how to clean them and when to replace the water.
- [What should I do during a power cut? A 3-day plan](https://beprepareddontfear.github.io/guides/power-cut-plan-3-days.html): What to prepare, what to do during and after, with fridge and freezer times.
